title: Product Extraction
summary: Extract patterns, textures, or product elements from a reference image and recompose them into a fresh studio shot. Image-to-image: pass `--image <path>` to the generator. Demonstrates fabric-from-dress extraction with three colour-graded drape variants on an orange backdrop — adapt the prompt for any extract-and-recombine flow.
prompt: Take the fabric from the dress and create three separate fabrics, then make a single studio shot where all three fabrics are draped on the ground, flowing and twisted together, each in a different color, with the logo printed on each one, against an orange background.
